detail.longDescription: Been building synap.md — a self-hosted, Obsidian-ish Markdown notes app. Web app + native Tauri/Rust desktop client, vault stays plain .md files, no lock-in. Still early alpha, rough edges everywhere. Would love feedback — and if local-first sync sounds like your kind of rabbit hole, contributors too. https:// github.com/BungeeDEV/synap-mon orepo # selfhosted # FOSS # opensource # rustlang # tauri
